title: Rams take 10-9 halftime lead with Kyren Williams 1-yard TD

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rams take 10-9 halftime lead with Kyren Williams 1-yard TD
sources.description: While the Rams’ offense was largely listless for the first 30 minutes of Sunday’s game against the Chargers, the team woke up late in the second quarter.
